The '''1924 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship''' was the 38th staging of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]]'s premier [[inter county|inter-county]] [[hurling]] tournament. The championship began on 4 May 1924 and ended on 14 December 1924.

The championship was won by [[Dublin GAA|Dublin]] who secured the title following a 5–3 to 2–6 defeat of [[Galway GAA|Galway]] in the All-Ireland final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |title=All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Roll of Honour |publisher=The GAA website |access-date=27 July 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110905085701/http://gaaweb.sitesuite.cn/page/roll_of_honour2.html |archive-date=5 September 2011 }}</ref> This was their fourth All-Ireland title.

Galway entered the championship as the [[1923 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|defending champions]].
